weep-fall-igzier.summary: Igzier survives a fall into the lower harbor when the Watcher suppresses apex predators, forcing them into deeper water just as the city experiences a silent volcanic pressure wave.
signals: Baitfish swimming with fins breaching, circling with no exit in the cove
Filter feeders clamped shut, refusing to strain the water
Harbor unusually quiet beneath the waterfall roar; no hunting clicks or wakes
Short sub-bass tremor from the arc before the shift
weep-fall-igzier.mechanism: Watcher pressure disorients or repels midwater predators that hunt by prey density, pushing them off the shelf. Concurrent volcanic microseism and sulfur hint reinforces the push. Igzier hits water into a transient predator void.
aftermath: Some fall victims are still taken by opportunists, but the main hunters stay deep
Baitfish remain stressed and pinned by the cove walls; surface breach schools persist for hours
Filter feeders hold until the chem pulse passes, then reopen as currents clear
Residents log the event as an omen; timing aligns with arc quieting and Watcher stirring
